subject: Greenline onboarding: performance validation playbook and timelines
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Kim <laura.kim@greenlinehealth.com>, Tim O'Connor <tim.o@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Greenline onboarding: performance validation playbook and timelines

Hi Laura / Tim,

Thanks again for the kickoff yesterday. Per our conversation I put together a concise benchmarking and acceptance playbook so we can align on success criteria and scheduling before the Dedicated environment handoff. Below are the high-level targets and the planned test phases.

Goals (success gates)
- Latency: p50 < 120 ms, p95 < 320 ms (95th percentile measured at request path from Greenline US region)
- Throughput: sustained 1,200 rps for 15m soak with no error-rate increase above 0.3%
- Cold-start warmup: median cold-start < 600 ms for scaled instances
- Token accuracy/regression: quality checks on a sample prompt set (we'll share the evals) must show no more than 2% regression against the baseline.

Planned test phases
1) Single-node smoke (non-blocking) — verify model correctness and baseline latency (30–60m)
2) Gradual ramp to target throughput (ramp: 0 -> 1,200 rps over 20m) — identify queuing/backpressure behavior
3) Soak at target (15m) — measure steady-state p95/p99 and error behavior
4) Failure injection (optional) — transient node drain to validate graceful degraded fallback to smaller model variant

Environment notes
- We propose running tests in your staging Dedicated pool in us-west-2 (model variant: rw-13b-quant-v2). If you'd prefer a different variant for closer parity with production, say so.
- Test traffic will use anonymized prompt samples you already shared; no PHI will be used.

Deliverables and timeline
- Mutual action plan doc (HubSpot link below) and shared Drive with test artifacts — I will upload the load scripts and configs by EOD today.
- Preliminary single-node run results: targeted for EOD 2027-03-08.
- Full validation readout + acceptance decision: targeted by 2027-03-10 (contingent on soak results).

Attachments planned: greenline_kpis.csv (your KPIs), rl-load-config.json (test config), redwood-load-script.tar.gz (load harness).

Next steps (for today)
- Please confirm the model variant and that staging Dedicated pool in us-west-2 is available for a 2-hour window on Monday 03/08.
- Share any additional KPI rows you want included in the CSV.

Thanks — copying Marissa and Dev to coordinate the harness and infra schedule.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Kim <laura.kim@greenlinehealth.com>

Date: Fri, 05 Mar 2027 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Greenline onboarding: performance validation playbook and timelines

Hi Naomi — thanks, this looks great and very clear. A couple quick questions before we lock windows: 

1) Model variant: we currently run rw-13b-fp16-prod in production. Is rw-13b-quant-v2 expected to be representative of our production latency profiles? If not, we should either run the fp16 or include a quantization delta in the readout.

2) Can we reserve a two-hour test window during 03/08 10:00–12:00 PDT? That works for our infra folks.

3) For soak, is 15m the minimum you recommend? We can extend to 30m if it reduces noise for p95/p99 measurement.

I've attached our KPI export (greenline_kpis.csv) — includes business endpoints and sample prompts we want prioritized. Also putting Tim on copy; he'll coordinate on the infra side.

Thanks,
Laura
Director, Platform Engineering
Greenline Health
laura.kim@greenlinehealth.com
